newsitem.title: UK: Kenwood shares drop after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Kenwood shares drop after profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Kenwood Appliances Plc tumbled in early trading on Tuesday after the maker of kitchen appliances warned that profits in the second half to April 4 would be well below the level in the first half.
The stock was down 44-1/2p or 24 percent at 141-1/2 by 0837 GMT.

Kenwood said trading continued to be very difficult in western Europe and margins were under pressure, while sterling's strength would also have a significant impact on profits since three-quarters of its business was done outside the UK.
The company added that managing director Tim Beech would leave at the end of February 1997 to be replaced by Colin Gordon, currently with Grand Metropolitan Plc.

Last month Kenwood shareholders voted against a resolution requiring it to talk to third parties about selling the company. Kenwood confirmed it had received an approach from rival Pifco but said it had never received a formal bid.
